title: Signal selection and signal plot
objective: Add the explicit channel+message+signal selection that drives the Plot, replacing the byte-0 fallback entirely. A new SignalSelectionControl renders, for the asset the user is inspecting, the channels that are bound to THAT asset (derived from the session's dbcBindings and nothing else - no channel registry), a message picker and the message's signals with a Plot action per signal. With exactly one bound channel the control may stand on it while still displaying which channel it is; with two or more it must not pick for the user, and Plot stays unavailable until a channel is named. Activating Plot calls session.selectSignal with the full four-part identity (channelId, assetId, messageName, signalName) plus the unit, and the write is re-checked against the binding map at the moment it happens so a binding removed between render and click cannot produce a selection whose channel decodes nothing. With no session, no asset or no bound channel the action is disabled while the reason is shown. components/plot/series.ts replaces buildByteSeries with the pure buildSignalSeries(records, selection, maxSamples): a record contributes a sample only when its assetId, its frame's channelId, its decoded messageName and the named signal ALL match, and the sample is { time: frame.normalizedTimestamp, value: signal.physicalValue } - the physical value, never the raw one, on the frame's own timestamp, never a decode-completion time. The series stays bounded and deterministic, keeping the first and last sample. LivePlotPanel draws that series with a y-axis named '<Signal> (<unit>)' or the bare signal name, shows an explicit no-selection state and an explicit waiting state, and never falls back to a payload byte.
scope: The signal-selection control, the plot series and the live plot panel, with their vitest suites.
non_goals: Any change to DbcDatabaseView, DbcWorkspace, DockWorkspace, the workspace session, the decoded store, the decoding client, the coordinator or i18n - the Main Agent wires the control in
Multi-signal, multi-axis, cursor, trigger or alarm behaviour
Any DBC parsing or signal-value computation in the Desktop
Any new i18n key or dependency
acceptance_criteria: Candidate channels come only from dbcBindings entries whose bound asset is the inspected one; no channel registry exists
One bound channel may be stood on while still being displayed; two or more require an explicit choice and Plot stays unavailable until then
Plot writes a selection carrying channelId, assetId, messageName and signalName, re-checked against the binding map at write time
The series takes a record only when channel, asset, message and signal all match, and uses physicalValue on normalizedTimestamp
The series is bounded and deterministic, retaining the first and last sample
The plot shows an explicit no-selection state and an explicit waiting state, and never falls back to a payload byte
The y-axis name includes the unit when the document declared one
handoff_requirements: Report the exact command and result for the focused vitest run, pnpm test, pnpm typecheck and pnpm lint
Name every new test case and state the RED observation that preceded each new behaviour, and list the byte-series tests that were removed
State explicitly that every file outside the six allowed paths was untouched, including LiveRealtimePanels.test.tsx, DbcDatabaseView.tsx and DbcWorkspace.tsx
